mapper.sql: card_order_id, order_no, member_id, member_name, member_phone, plan_code, plan_name, amount, credits, valid_days, venue_code, note, status, created_at, activated_at, activated_by, applied_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volt_card_order (card_order_id, order_no, member_id, member_name, member_phone, plan_code, plan_name, amount, credits, valid_days, venue_code, note, status, created_at) VALUES (#{cardOrderId}, #{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{planCode}, #{planName}, #{amount}, #{credits}, #{validDays}, #{venueCode}, #{note}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM volt_card_order WHERE member_phone = #{phone} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT FROM volt_card_order WHERE member_phone = #{phone} AND status = 'activated' AND applied_at IS NULL ORDER BY activated_at ASC, created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volt_card_order WHERE member_phone = #{phone} AND plan_code = #{planCode} AND status = 'pending'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volt_card_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE volt_card_order SET member_id = #{memberId}, applied_at = NOW() WHERE card_order_id = #{cardOrderId} AND applied_at IS NULL
